name: Combined Immunodeficiency with Normal Immunoglobulin Levels and Poor Specific Antibody Response
aliases: CID with Normal Ig and Impaired Specific Antibody Production
Combined Immunodeficiency with Selective Antibody Deficiency

criteria.description: Normal serum immunoglobulin (IgG, IgA, IgM) levels
Impaired specific antibody response to vaccines or infections despite normal total Ig levels
History of recurrent, severe, or unusual infections indicative of immunodeficiency
Abnormal T and/or B lymphocyte subset counts or function
Family history of immunodeficiency or related disorders

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of normal total immunoglobulin levels with documented poor specific antibody response and recurrent infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of antibody deficiency and confirmation by immunological testing.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Poor antibody response to polysaccharide vaccines
searchTerms: poor vaccine response to polysaccharide types
weak antibody production after certain vaccines

laboratory: Normal serum IgG, IgA, and IgM levels
Reduced or absent specific antibody titers post-vaccination
imaging: Chest radiographs showing recurrent pneumonia or bronchiectasis
genetic: Mutations in genes affecting lymphocyte function (varies by case)
other: Poor vaccine response documented by immunization challenge tests

distinguishingFeatures: Profound T and B cell lymphopenia

redFlags: Recurrent severe bacterial infections despite normal Ig levels
Poor or absent antibody response to vaccines
Development of bronchiectasis or chronic lung disease
references: Orange JS, et al. Use and interpretation of diagnostic vaccination in primary immunodeficiency: a working group report of the Basic and Clinical Immunology Interest Section of the American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2012.

Picard C, et al. Primary Immunodeficiency Diseases: An Update on the Classification from the International Union of Immunological Societies Expert Committee for Primary Immunodeficiency. Front Immunol. 2015.
